description.value: Smugglers Cove Pub is a cozy British-style tavern in the Cadboro Bay neighbourhood of Victoria, featuring a second-floor deck and 12 draught beers including local and imported ales. The menu covers global comfort fare — fish and chips, burgers, and more — with a loyal neighbourhood following and a welcoming atmosphere for visitors. An attached liquor store adds convenience for cyclists stocking up.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 59m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active pub/restaurant at 2581 Penrhyn St, Cadboro Bay — contradicting the OSM address of 3837 Cadboro Bay Road. The OSM name 'Smuggler's Cove Liquor Store' refers only to a component of the business; the website presents it as 'Smugglers Cove Pub' primarily. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('DINE-IN and TAKEOUT 7 DAYS A WEEK'); no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
